T0676.title: Soulbound Token
T0676.definition: A soulbound token is a credential-like token bound to a particular on-chain account and generally not freely transferable.
T0676.description: Soulbound tokens represent education, membership, reputation, or other identity attributes that should not be readily traded. Transfer restrictions reduce credential markets and identity rental, but issuers still need to address trust, erroneous-credential revocation, account recovery, privacy exposure, and false reputation created through batches of accounts.
T0676.usageExample: A community issues a Soulbound Token to wallets whose contributions have been reviewed, using it as an on-chain eligibility credential for governance.
